title: The dashboard wears Night Yard: a neo-noir default theme, a selectable remembered Daylight, WCAG AA text in both, and reduced motion stopping the rain, glitch and pulse
description: A real browser on the built dashboard: a fresh visit serves Night Yard (near-black blue, neon status colours, rain over grain); the theme menu offers Daylight, which loads on return (remembered per browser); an automated contrast audit of the Work page, an item page, the command palette and the shortcut sheet finds no text below WCAG AA in either theme; with prefers-reduced-motion the rain, glitch-flicker and ship-pulse animations do not run, and with motion on they do; the glitch and the pulse skip when Fun is off. The playful copy names the agents runners (a builder's row reads like Juno is running GY-3272, the strip counts runners on shift), while plain labels keep their words — the Master page's title reads Master with Fun on and off — and with Fun off the strip counts agents working.

steps.name: theme, contrast audit and reduced motion on the dashboard
